places: Rio de la Plata/Parana river mouth

fields.climate: warm temperate; freezing temperatures almost unknown
fields.terrain: mostly rolling plains and low hills; fertile coastal lowland
fields.hazards: seasonally high winds (the pampero is a chilly and occasional violent wind that blows north from the Argentine pampas), droughts, floods…
fields.resources: arable land, hydropower, minor minerals, fish
fields.farm: milk, rice, wheat, barley, soybeans, beef, rapeseed, sugarcane, maize, beef offal
fields.exports: wood pulp, beef, milk, rice, wood
fields.industries: food processing, electrical machinery, transportation equipment, petroleum products, textiles, chemicals, beverages
fields.languages: Spanish (official, Rioplatense is the most widely spoken dialect)
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 36.5%, Protestant 5% (Evangelical (non-specific) 4.6%, Adventist 0.2%, Protestant (non-specific) 0.3%), African American Cults/Umbanda 2.8%, Jehovah's Witness 0.6%, Church of Jesus…
fields.legal: civil law system based on the Spanish civil code
fields.suffrage: 18 years of age; universal and compulsory
fields.military: generally 18-30 years of age (up to 22 for the Navy and up to 40 for some specialist positions) for voluntary military service for men and women; initial 24-month service obligation
